newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Britain urges US to sign telecoms pact.
newsitem.headline: Britain urges US to sign telecoms pact.

text.p: Britain urged the United States on Friday to sign a global telecoms pact being negotiated in Geneva amid doubts an accord could be reached by Saturday's deadline because of the tough U.S. line at the talks.
"I would certainly urge the Americans to live up to their rhetoric...and sign up to an accord," British Minister for Science and Technology Ian Taylor told a news briefing.

Taylor said he believed there was enough on the table for a deal. He said liberalisation of the telecoms market had brought tremendous boom to the industry in Britain and predicted a deal in Geneva would have a similar effect around the world.

U.S. officials declined to give a detailed assessment of the state of play, but they said their team to the World Trade Organisation negotiations insisted better offers were still needed from other countries.
One Western trade envoy said the Americans were playing very hard. "It's beginning to look somewhat doubtful unless something gives somewhere."
